description: Authoritative list of optional audio files for Gremios del Alba. Every file is optional: the game stays silent for any file that is not present.
style: Cozy hand-drawn fantasy RTS: warm, soft, organic, storybook; never harsh, gory or sci-fi.

sfx.prompt: Soft wooden button click, small warm tap on a carved wooden toggle, cozy fantasy game menu, clean, no reverb
Gentle parchment scroll unrolling with a soft paper swoosh, cozy fantasy game interface panel opening
Wooden stakes knocked into soft earth, a couple of light mallet taps, placing a building foundation in a cozy fantasy village
Final hammer strikes on timber followed by a short warm wooden chime, a cozy fantasy village building is finished
Short cheerful lute pluck with light footsteps on a wooden floor, a new villager steps out, cozy fantasy strategy game
Old book closing softly followed by a magical sparkling glimmer, a discovery in a cozy fantasy library
Warm triumphant fanfare of horns and soft bells rising, a fantasy village enters a new age at dawn, storybook feel
Two light axe chops into a tree trunk with small wood splinters, outdoors in a gentle forest, cozy and soft
Two light pickaxe taps on rock with small pebbles falling, outdoor quarry, soft and cozy fantasy
Light sword clash on a wooden shield, short metallic ring, stylized fantasy combat, not gory
Bowstring twang and an arrow whooshing away, light and crisp, fantasy archer
Magical fireball whoosh ending in a soft fiery burst with crackling embers, storybook fantasy spell
Gentle healing spell, soft shimmering chimes and a warm airy glow, calm fantasy magic
Mystical choir hum with a soft magical swell and bell, a soldier is persuaded to join another side, fantasy
Soft thud of a figure falling onto grass with a faint cloth rustle, stylized and non-violent, fantasy strategy game
Wooden building collapsing, timber creaking and cracking then falling into a dusty rubble pile, fantasy village, not too loud
Joyful orchestral victory fanfare with horns, strings and bells, warm storybook fantasy ending
Melancholic slow descending strings and a soft low horn, gentle fantasy defeat, sad but not dark
Distant medieval war horn blowing an alarm call twice over a valley, fantasy village warning
